decisions.statement: One line has one reading, as a line beside an agent's own page has.
A subagent's page going appends the readings that subagent had made.
A line says the agent id the reading was made by.
A reading here answers nothing the seat itself is asked.
A line goes back to its subagent's own readings as that subagent's page does.
This file goes once the last line it holds has gone back.
A line goes where the sweep takes away the page of the subagent that made it.
An ordinary take-down drops no line here, its subagent being able to resume.
A line goes where its subagent's last record predates the client the seat runs.
A line going back to its own page beats a line going for being that old.
A line neither given back, swept, nor outlived goes with the seat's own page.
Lines are kept outside the commit.
No author writes a line here by hand.

definition: the readings a subagent under a seat had made when its page went
